--auth.help: Filter by auth type (Unauth, Auth, Privileged)

--details.help: Show detailed CVE entries per plugin

--file.help: File containing a list of URLs

--header.help: HTTP header to include in requests. Can be specified multiple times.

--mode.help: Scan mode: stealthy, bruteforce, or hybrid

--output.help: Output file to save results (csv, json)

--plugin-list.help: Path to a custom plugin list file for bruteforce mode

--rate-limit.help: Maximum requests per second (0 = unlimited). Default 50 to avoid flooding network.

--severity.help: Filter by severity (critical, high, medium, low)

list.help: Show how many CVEs wpprobe can detect, split by severity

scan.help: Scan a WordPress site for installed plugins and vulnerabilities

uninstall.help: Uninstalls WPProbe and removes all related files and the binary
